name: Avatar
description: A person or a business: a photo over their initials, or an icon.

name.description: Data, not copy: gives the initials and the accessible name.

src.description: A photo over the initials, which stay if it fails. An image URL.

icon.description: An anonymous person. A name from the icon list.

color.description: Without one, a steady colour from the name; default is the neutral grey.

presence.description: A dot at the bottom of the end side, read after the name. Not drawn in a stack.

isRinged.description: A gilt ring 2 outside the avatar, to pick one out. Not drawn in a stack.
